title: Breakbeat
tagline: Rhythm as the main event, with sharp accents and off-kilter energy.
summary: Breakbeat puts rhythmic displacement at the center of the song, using syncopated drum patterns to create motion and tension. It emerged from club culture, where dancers needed a groove that could feel urgent, elastic and slightly unpredictable. The style sits between electronic dance music and the more open textures of experimental club production.

pillars.name: The Prodigy
pillars.why: The Prodigy made breakbeat feel immediate, loud and unmistakably club-ready.

pillars.name: A Guy Called Gerald
pillars.why: A Guy Called Gerald helped define breakbeat as a rhythmic language with a strong sense of movement and atmosphere.

pillars.name: Photek
pillars.why: Photek linked breakbeat to a more atmospheric and bass-heavy club aesthetic.
